cues: A Polaroid is a thin sheet that passes light vibrating in one direction only.
Edwin Land made the first in nineteen twenty eight, from tiny aligned needle crystals of herapathite.
Modern sheets are polyvinyl alcohol, stretched so that its long molecules all lie parallel, then soaked in iodine.
